# The Aptitude Academy

> The Aptitude Academy helps South African companies run learnership programmes and helps unemployed learners explore suitable opportunities.

## Services

- Learner recruitment
- Placement with registered SETA training providers
- Learnership programme management, including stipends, costs and learner progress support

## Who we help

- Companies with skills-development and learnership needs, including B-BBEE-related requirements
- Unemployed learners seeking to express interest in suitable learnership opportunities

## Important facts

- Learner registration is an expression of interest, not a guaranteed placement.
- Training is delivered by registered SETA training providers; The Aptitude Academy coordinates recruitment, placement and programme administration.
- Contact: admin@theaptitudeacademy.co.za or +27 81 805 8686.
